from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":213,"var":"Data[0]","code":"int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;","note":"The first attacker-controlled byte selects the target architecture/mode pair, so the rest of the payload is interpreted under the chosen decoder."},
  {"step":2,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":215,"var":"handle","code":"err = cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);","note":"The selected platform opens Capstone in x86 Intel mode when the first byte maps to item 0 or 1, enabling the x86 printer path."},
  {"step":3,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":223,"var":"Data+1","code":"size_t count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);","note":"The remaining bytes are passed as raw instruction bytes to Capstone, making the crafted sequence the direct input to decoding and printing."},
  {"step":4,"file":"arch/X86/X86Module.c","function":"<global>","line":21,"var":"ud->printer","code":"ud->printer = X86_Intel_printInst;","note":"For x86 Intel syntax, decoded instructions are formatted by the Intel printer, which is the sink implicated by the MSan report."},
  {"step":5,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst","line":769,"var":"MI->assembly[0]","code":"if (MI->assembly[0]) { strncpy(O->buffer, MI->assembly, sizeof(O->buffer)); return; }","note":"If LLVM does not provide a preformatted assembly string, Capstone falls through to operand-specific formatting logic."},
  {"step":6,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst","line":779,"var":"printInstruction(MI, O, Info)","code":"printInstruction(MI, O, Info);","note":"The instruction is printed through the generic x86 formatter, which may consult operand metadata that was not fully initialized by decoding."},
  {"step":7,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printPCRelImm","line":804,"var":"imm","code":"int64_t imm = MCOperand_getImm(Op) + MI->flat_insn->size + MI->address;","note":"The root-cause hypothesis is that this operand-printing path reads an uninitialized immediate/operand value while computing a PC-relative target, triggering the reported use-of-uninitialized-value in X86_Intel_printInst."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
